name: mcp-nokotime
description: Access and manage your Noko time tracking entries, projects, and users directly from Claude.
long_description: Interact with the [Noko time tracking API](https://api.nokotime.com/v2) from Claude. List, create, edit, and delete time entries; search projects; and list users. Includes date-range convenience tools (past week, past month, current week) for fast time reporting.

noko_api_token.title: Noko API Token
noko_api_token.description: Your personal Noko API token. Find it at nokotime.com → Profile → API token.

tools.name: noko_list_entries
tools.description: List time entries with optional filters and pagination, or get a specific entry by ID

tools.name: noko_get_project_entries_past_week
tools.description: Get time entries for a project from the past 7 days

tools.name: noko_get_project_entries_past_month
tools.description: Get time entries for a project from the past 30 days

tools.name: noko_get_project_entries_current_week
tools.description: Get time entries for a project from the current week (Monday to Sunday)

tools.name: noko_get_project_entries_date_range
tools.description: Get time entries for a project with flexible date range presets

tools.name: noko_list_projects
tools.description: List all available projects with optional filtering and pagination

tools.name: noko_list_users
tools.description: List all users with optional filtering and pagination
